meta.name: abstract-automation
meta.description: Automate Abstract tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 让 Abstract 任务自动运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Abstract 上处理版本更新和协作任务。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Abstract for design version control and want to automate frequent actions.

howto.what: Claude 可以自动执行 Abstract 平台上的任务，例如创建项目、更新状态、管理数据等，通过 Rube MCP 连接并操作。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 操作 Abstract（如管理项目、更新任务）或需要自动化 Abstract 工作流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Abstract 创建一个新项目，名为“测试”。
say.note: Claude 会连接 Abstract 并执行创建。

say.text: 把 Abstract 中项目“设计”的状态改为“已完成”。
say.note: Claude 会搜索相应工具并更新。

howto.what_en: Claude can automate tasks on Abstract platform, such as creating projects, updating statuses, managing data, etc., by connecting via Rube MCP and executing tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to operate Abstract (e.g., manage projects, update tasks) or automate Abstract workflows.

say_en.text: Create a new project in Abstract named 'Test'.
say_en.note: Claude will connect and execute the creation.

say_en.text: Update the status of project 'Design' to 'Completed' in Abstract.
say_en.note: Claude will search tools and update.
